sentences.en: I cannot look back on my adolescence without feeling depressed.
sentences.zh: 我回顾青春期时总是感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Adolescence is a period of transition between childhood and adulthood.
sentences.zh: 青春期是从童年过渡到成年的时期。

sentences.en: How long adolescence continues is determined by biological factors.
sentences.zh: 青春期持续多久由生物学因素决定。
